name: Natsu☆Kanon
source:
Main character lives with aunt and childhood friend, but he leaves his home town to search a place for self-realization. One short summer seven years later he returns to his old friends. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-may-2003-ashita-deatta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公与姑姑和青梅竹马共同生活，却为了寻找能够实现自我价值的地方而离开故乡。七年后，在一个短暂的夏日里，他回到故乡，与昔日的朋友们重逢。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-may-2003-ashita-deatta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
